create.title: Derived level-four completed Appell scalar specialization and source limits
create.statement_tex: Let F(tau)=sum_(m>=1) C(m)e(m tau), where C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r), and let H(tau)=(1/2) Ahat_4(1/2,-3tau;2tau). The audited completed Appell/Jacobi laws, specialized by an internal elliptic-shift calculation, give H=F+1/4+sum_(a=0)^3 R_a and H(gamma tau)=chi_4(d)(c tau+d)H(tau) for gamma=(a b;c d) in Gamma_0(4). Here R_a=(i/4)(-1)^a theta((2a-3)tau+3/2;8tau)R_Zw(1/2+(3-2a)tau;8tau). The residual integral exponential is e[-c(d+3b)/4]=1. This scalar law is a derived specialization, not a verbatim source theorem or a rediscovery of the Round-63 Appell identity. The holomorphic F is not modular alone, the constant and four corrections are compulsory, the full modular group acts on a characteristic orbit, and neither harmonicity nor a square-root coefficient summation bound follows from the audited sources.
create.next_action: Use the scalar law only with the constant and all four corrections retained. Reopen a coefficient-summation route only after proving the required analytic class and a bound for all five completed pairings in the individual complex direction.

create.title: Completed Appell five-owner pairing and reciprocal self-return obstruction
create.statement_tex: For the exact cone coefficient C, the completed scalar H=F+1/4+sum_(a=0)^3 R_a is real-analytic of weight one with nebentypus chi_4 on Gamma_0(4), but coefficient extraction consists of one completed pairing minus four correction pairings and no audited theorem bounds these five owners for the literal square-root test. After the target-safe cells are globally restored and exact character Poisson is applied to a smooth dyadic block, the positive-j interior principal family, for 0<j<sqrt(N), has full factor e(1/8)N^(-1/4)chi_4(j)/h times the exact profiles and e(Nh/j); j=sqrt(N) belongs to the endpoint/Fresnel ledger. After the half-boundary, subtraction, negative alias, collar, entry/exit, profile, and remainder owners are reassembled, this is inverse to the Round-140 factor e(-1/8)N^(1/4) and returns the same reciprocal height-alias owner. The Round-142 denominator-Abel completion still reconstructs r_2/4 rather than C and leaves the negative-character sector and moving wedge. Cone capacity M^(1/4+o(1)), top capacity R^(1/2+o(1)), and reciprocal capacity N^(1/4) asymptotic to R are upper capacities, not signed lower bounds. Thus the completed-Appell mechanism proves neither the masked cone target nor a strict automorphic signed survivor.
create.next_action: Park completion-only modularity, coefficient-only extraction, correction deletion, hard-mask transforms, cosine substitution, and another reciprocal stationary transform. Reopen only with a new fixed-centre signed correlation theorem for the large-displacement survivor that controls every restored owner.

update.title: Exact far-cone and gcd-averaged nearest-square reduction
update.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), fix 0<rho<1/8, let A_rho(m) be the exact Round-140 incomplete coefficient, and let C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r). On disjoint half-open dyadic blocks I_M in the profile support, put k_m=floor(sqrt(Nm)+1/2) and j_m=k_m^2-Nm. For every J>=1, the accepted pointwise root estimate rho_N(j)<<_epsilon N^epsilon sqrt((N,j)), averaged as sum_(1<=|j|<=J)sqrt((N,j))<<_epsilon JN^epsilon and combined with k_m<N, gives #{m in I_M:0<|j_m|<=J}<<_epsilon JX^epsilon. If N=Du^2 with D squarefree, j_m=0 iff m=Dt^2 and that exact-radical channel is target-safe; in total #{m in I_M:|j_m|<=J}<<_epsilon (J+sqrt(M)+1)X^epsilon for J>=0. The nonzero J-window has weighted price M^(-3/4)JX^epsilon. Hence the exact frozen scalar equals sum_M sum_(m in I_M, |j_m|>M^(3/4)) m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)C(m)e(sqrt(Nm))+O_(epsilon,rho,V)(X^epsilon). The exponent 3/4 is maximal only for this absolute root-count plus divisor-bound ledger. The survivor is not estimated, and the phase-value gap gives no arbitrary rational-slope separation.
update.next_action: Attack the strict large-displacement survivor |j_m|>M^(3/4) by a genuinely signed fixed-centre mechanism. The wider target-safe deletion is arithmetic support information only and does not provide derivative-arc exclusion or a bound.

update.statement_tex: For the far scalar, nearest-integer phase cells have length O(R^(-1)) and contain at most one integer. Retaining the gcd in the accepted congruence root bound prices the nonzero window |j|<=J by M^(-3/4)JX^epsilon, so the present absolute method reaches target scale at J=M^(3/4), not sqrt(M), and proves no larger fixed power. Writing m=2^nu n with n odd gives the exact identity sigma_chi4(n)=(1+chi_4(n))A_nu(n)+B_nu(n): on chi_4(n)=-1 it is blind, and on chi_4(n)=1 it returns the complete r_2(2^nu n)/4 coefficient plus an exact owner-sized central band. For fixed c_0 and 2<=M<=c_0 y, y=floor(sqrt(X)), the literal incomplete coefficient satisfies sum_(m<=M)A_rho(m)e(m/4)=i*pi*M/8+O_(rho,c_0)(M^(3/4)) and its m^(-3/4)-weighted version is i*pi*M^(1/4)/2+O_(rho,c_0)(log(2M)), so uniform additive cancellation and low variation are false. After target-safe ratio smoothing the exact double-Mellin arithmetic factor is 4^(-t)zeta(s+t)L(s-t,chi_4), but the audited dispersion, complete radial, standard-twist, subconvex, moment, and rational-spectrum routes retain a positive R-power, have the wrong coefficient or scalar direction, fail a stated hypothesis, or return the same owner. These are scoped no-go controls, not a signed lower bound or target failure.
update.next_action: Retain the corrected M^(3/4) absolute cell threshold, the full 4|q hierarchy, r_2/4 Abel mismatch, and moving wedge. Reopen only with a new signed fixed-centre theorem for the surviving large-displacement cells.

update.statement_tex: For C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r), F(tau)=sum_(m>=1)C(m)e(m tau) satisfies A_4(1/2,-3tau;2tau)=1/2+2F(tau). Its completed scalar H=(1/2)Ahat_4(1/2,-3tau;2tau) equals F+1/4 plus four compulsory theta--R_Zw corrections and has weight one and nebentypus chi_4 on Gamma_0(4). For w in C_c^infty((0,infinity)), sum_(m>=1)C(m)w(m) equals one half sum_h w(4h^2) plus (i/2)sum_(h>=1,j nonzero)chi_4(j){h^(-1)int_(4h^2)^infinity w(u)e(-ju/(4h))du-2w(4h^2)/(pi i j)}, with the bracketed double sum interpreted in the accepted symmetric absolutely convergent recombination. For the restored dyadic square-root test and 0<j<sqrt(N), the integral inside braces has principal amplitude 2N^(-1/4)/h and Gaussian e(-1/8); after the outer i/2 the full principal factor is e(1/8)N^(-1/4)/h. The equality j=sqrt(N) remains an endpoint/Fresnel case, while j>sqrt(N) has no interior saddle. This legacy reduction alone supplies no coefficient bound or strict automorphic survivor.

Another completion or stationary transform is parked unless a new signed correlation estimate prevents aggregate self-return.

reject.reason: F alone is not modular; the separate 1/4 and all four nonholomorphic corrections are compulsory.
Only real-analytic modular covariance is proved; harmonicity and the hypotheses of standard harmonic-Maass coefficient summation formulas are absent.
The fixed section is scalar only on Gamma_0(4); the full modular group moves a finite characteristic orbit.
There are four compulsory correction terms plus a separate isotropic constant, and no target-safe bound permits deleting them.
The coefficient transform requires a smooth test; the hard mask is handled only through the separately proved global target-safe cell restoration.
The target is one individual complex direction; no exact bridge from a cosine or conjugate pair is proved.
It is only the interior principal family. The endpoint/Fresnel, boundary, subtraction, alias, profile, and remainder owners remain compulsory.
The completed torsion section and the denominator-Abel coefficient completion are different operations; the latter reconstructs r_2/4 rather than C.
The induced special-slope gap is only R^(-3) times the natural derivative-cell width and says nothing about an arbitrary rational slope.
The proved absolute price is M^(-3/4)JX^epsilon, so this ledger is target-safe only through J=M^(3/4).
The displayed R^(1/2) and R capacities are unsigned upper prices and do not preclude cancellation in the fixed-centre complex scalar.
The strict large-displacement survivor, collar-tail cross owner, direct M1 parents, all M2 parents, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, and quarter target remain open.
